goal: Let node operators specify the local source address for outbound clearnet P2P connections.
Helps multi-homed hosts choose an outbound interface instead of relying on OS routing tables.
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now.
agreement: Strong support with no open objections.
Objections against altering -bind resolved by adding a separate -outboundbind option (luke-jr, gmaxwell)
Substantive support for keeping -bind semantics unchanged and adding a dedicated option (vasild)
Concept and approach approvals on the revised interface (frankomosh, winterrdog)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it resolves an edge-case routing limitation for operators running across multiple interfaces.
The benefit is confined to specific multi-homed configurations and is safe to defer.
